documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year, with EBITDA of INR 189.8 crores and reported PAT of INR 129 crores. The company generated positive operating cash flow of INR 136 crores in H1 FY27 while net debt reduced to INR 531 crores as of September 2026. Management highlighted driving capital efficiency through an increased share of Advance Gold billing and rapid growth in exports alongside higher-margin studded and diamond jewelry. Management also noted that due to SEBI compliance restrictions, it is not providing explicit forward-looking guidance. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹2,390.7 crore for Q2 FY27 and ₹4,403.5 crore for H1 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management stated that its past margin percentage guidance remains on track despite regulatory restrictions on providing future guidance.
guidance.quote: Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance, but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold surpassed its original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 crore a year early.
guidance.quote: Original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr surpassed a year early

guidance.claim: Sky Gold remains on track to achieve its revenue target of INR 8,100 crores by FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company expects sales growth of 30% to 35%.
guidance.quote: Considering these, and my ROCE is close to 35%- 36%, we expect that we will go to 30% to 35% in terms of the sales increase.

guidance.claim: The company guides for export revenue to reach 20% in coming years.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting good sales export as we have guided that we will go to 20% exports in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed a shift in consumer karatage preference from 22-karat to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a significant shift from the unorganized to organized sector in the B2B space.
demand_outlook.quote: Further, our export business is also doing well. In addition to the B2C segment, our B2B business is also growing very fast, and there is a significant shift from unorganized to organized sector, which is happening on the B2B space as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Uncut diamond jewelry is experiencing strong consumer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Uncut diamonds, uncut diamond jewelry is in strong demand and carries high margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower karatage products (18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT) now contribute nearly 14% of volume due to rising gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation. They now contribute close to 14% of volume and has gross margin contribution of close to 1.4% to 1.5%.

demand_outlook.claim: In the jewelry sector, 60% of the B2C segment and 80% of the B2B segment remain unorganized.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, only 40% of the sector is organized and 60% of the sector is unorganized on the B2C side. While on the B2B side, only 20% is organized and 80% is unorganized.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold built an international order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across UK and European markets following an expo.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established its international office in Dubai in September 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: In September 2025, we started operations of our international office in Dubai, led by Mr. Hiralal, who brings 30 plus years of experience in Dubai and GCC.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Purvi Gold at INR 9 crores compared to a book value of INR 6 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Purvi Gold (Uncut Diamonds) acquired at INR9 crores versus book value of INR6 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Shri. Rishabh Gold for less than INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Shri. Rishabh Gold (Mangalsutra) acquired at less than INR10 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded its manufacturing footprint to 150,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at 55% to 57%, which is sufficient to support operations until 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028.

capex_expansion.claim: Any new facility post-2028 will follow a leased model with an estimated capex of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 reached INR 229 crores with a gross margin of 9.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%. Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 189.8 crores with an EBITDA margin of 7.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs increased to 1.6% of sales due to investments in executive management, design teams, and control functions.
margins_costs.quote: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales, as we invested in people: a CEO, a larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.

margins_costs.claim: Advance gold billing adds 110 basis points to gross margin while requiring virtually no working capital.
margins_costs.quote: Because we billed only making charges, it adds 110 basis points to gross margin while needing almost no working capital.

margins_costs.claim: The company follows a strict back-to-back hedging policy to avoid speculative gold positions.
margins_costs.quote: At the financial and the risk management level, we follow a strict back-to-back hedging policy and do not undertake speculative position in gold.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added business served as the main driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Implementation of an ERP system helped monitor operational KPIs and reduce gold loss.
margins_costs.quote: Implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin improved by 27 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 9.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The Advance Gold business contributes 90 to 100 basis points directly to revenue and gross margin.
margins_costs.quote: First, the Advance Gold contributes close to 90 to 100 bps in revenue and gross margin, since this flows into the gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased to INR 157 crores, representing a margin of 7.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company delivers complex jewelry orders within a timeline of less than 30 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We deliver in less than 30 days, significantly faster delivery timeline for the complex products that we are selling.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly manufacturing volumes at Shri. Rishabh Gold increased to 150 kg from 20-25 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: Their monthly volumes have grown from about 20 kg to 25 kg to 150 kg.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 40 3D printing machines for paper casting.
orders_capacity.quote: We adopted 3D printing with paper casting as early as 2020, and now run 40 such machines.

orders_capacity.claim: Nearly 16% of total product volume comes from advanced metal manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: Nearly 16% of our volume comes from advanced metal, which employs no capital of ours.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's overall manufacturing capacity utilization is currently at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold has a production capacity of 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Advance Gold sales reached 17% in Q1 FY27, exceeding the full-year FY27 expectation of 15%.
orders_capacity.quote: I am pleased to share that we have achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, significantly ahead of our expectation of 15% of the Advance Gold model for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: First-half FY27 operating cash flow reached INR 136 crores compared to an outflow of INR 100.9 crores in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: H1 operating cash flow was INR136 crores, against the outflow of INR100.9 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt was reduced to INR 531 crores at the end of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt was INR531 crores at September end, and versus INR550 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital cycle declined to 55 days in September 2026 from 63 days in September 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: net working capital is now 55 days, down from 59 days in March '26, 63 days in September '25, 71 days in March '25.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27 and will receive payouts solely through dividends from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 540 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management's primary capital allocation priority is balance sheet strengthening and debt reduction.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will transition to a zero-salary compensation model starting in FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company took an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: SEBI compliance norms restrict the company from quantifying the breakdown and utilization of fundraise proceeds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to SEBI norms, we are not allowed to quantify the break-down of proceeds and utilization.

risks_headwinds.claim: Upward pressure on US interest rates impacts Gold Metal Loan borrowing rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: And considering that, we are currently not availing the gold metal loan. But yes, what point that you are asking is in the right direction, that the upward pressure on the US interest rates will also have an impact on the lending rates as well, and specifically on the GML borrowing rates.

risks_headwinds.claim: Recent volatility in gold prices has exerted margin pressure across jewelry manufacturers and retailers.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company was impacted by an incident involving INR 10.7 crores, of which INR 3.5 crores has been recovered.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to taking a salary only when there is positive operating cash flow.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to acquiring the proposed land themselves if a third-party commitment is not finalized within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will draw no salary starting from FY27, receiving payouts solely through operating cash flow dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold aims to achieve revenue of INR 8,100 crores by FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model beginning FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects Advance Gold business to average 15% this year.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved 18% Advance Gold business, and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
